subject: bakery
title: Model Question Paper 2
meta: Time: 2 hours · Maximum marks: 40 · Modelled on the April 2026 NIOS paper (code 256)
instructions: All questions are compulsory and carry marks as indicated against each question.
Question 1: fifteen fill-in-the-blanks (1 mark each). Question 2: fifteen True/False statements (1 mark each). Question 3: four questions of 2½ marks each.
Questions from previous NIOS papers show the exam they appeared in.

sections.title: Fill in the blanks and write the correct answers.

questions.q: The chemical name of ________ is sodium chloride.
Whole wheat flour consists of bran, ________ and germ.
Too much handling of short crust dough results in the fat becoming ________.
The base of a Swiss roll is a ________ sponge.
Cakes without icing contain a high percentage of ________.
A cake decorated with cream icing can be stored in a refrigerator for a maximum of ________ days.
Butter ________ is a mix of butter and icing sugar.
To prepare pastry dough, we need ________ water for mixing.
The main ingredients to prepare puff pastry are fat and ________.
Salt controls the rate of ________ in baking.
________ by milk or eggs is done by pastry brush.
Doughnuts are flavoured with ________ powder.
Croissant is a rich, yeast based bread dough high in ________.
Gross profit is the selling price minus the ________ cost.
Accounting has three stages: primary entry, secondary entry and ________ accounts.

sections.title: State whether the following statements are True or False.

questions.q: Yeast is available in dry form only.
questions.answer: False. It is available both fresh and dry.

questions.q: Fresh yeast may be stored at room temperature.
questions.answer: False. Fresh yeast is kept in a refrigerator (a couple of weeks) or frozen.

questions.q: A cold area is more suitable for making biscuits.
questions.answer: True. Ingredients and the working area should be cool so that the fat does not melt.

questions.q: Christmas cakes have lots of dry fruits.
Madeira cakes are cakes with icing.
questions.answer: False. They are cakes without icing.

questions.q: Buttercream is a mix of egg yolk, butter and flour.
questions.answer: False. It is a mix of butter (fat) and icing sugar.

questions.q: Royal icing is beaten with an egg beater to incorporate air.
questions.answer: False. It is beaten with a fork.

questions.q: Lemon juice may be added while making puff pastry.
Puff and flaky pastes always give different products.
questions.answer: False. The products that can be made are the same with a slight variation in texture.

questions.q: The bread's volume and shape are internal characteristics.
Eggs are non essential ingredients in bread making.
questions.answer: True. The four essential ingredients are flour, yeast, water and salt.

questions.q: We cannot store brioche dough in a refrigerator as yeast will die.
questions.answer: False. Brioche dough can be stored for a day or two in the refrigerator.

questions.q: The main ingredient in preparing doughnuts is almond powder.
Accounting is divided into 3 steps.
questions.answer: True. Primary entry, secondary entry (classification) and final accounts.

questions.q: Entering a business transaction in a journal is journalising.

sections.title: Answer the following questions (five points each).

questions.q: Describe the steps of preparing a butter sponge.
questions.answer: (i) Sieve flour with baking powder. (ii) Cream fat and castor sugar until light, fluffy and white. (iii) Add the beaten eggs and vanilla a little at a time. (iv) Fold in the flour with a palette knife and add milk to get a dropping consistency. (v) Pour into a prepared tin, bake at 170 C for about 20 minutes and cool on a rack.

questions.q: Differentiate between flaky pastry and puff pastry.
questions.answer: (i) Puff pastry has fat and flour in the ratio 1:1; flaky pastry has 3/4 fat to every kilogram of flour. (ii) In puff pastry all the fat is folded in at one rolling; in flaky pastry it is divided into three parts and folded in three rollings. (iii) Puff pastry has more layers; flaky pastry has fewer. (iv) Puff pastry has four empty rollings; flaky pastry has only one empty rolling.

questions.q: Mention any three internal characteristics of bread to judge its quality.
questions.answer: (i) Internal colour is influenced by the type and quality of flour; a proper crumb structure reflects light. (ii) Structure: gas cells of the right size and evenly distributed, as per the formula of the bread. (iii) Flavour and aroma and moistness: under-fermented bread lacks aroma, over-fermented bread is sourish; stale bread is dry.

questions.q: A bakery made sales of Rs. 16,500 in a month and the material cost was Rs. 6,500. Find the gross profit in rupees and as a percentage of sales.
questions.answer: (i) Gross profit = selling price - material cost. (ii) = 16,500 - 6,500 = Rs. 10,000. (iii) Percentage = (10,000 / 16,500) x 100. (iv) = 60.6% (approximately) of sales.
